rule: The 30 largest road freight flows between the 15 mainland autonomous communities in 2025, in tonnes, both directions summed. It counts the Spanish-registered heavy trucks (over 3.5 t) that the EPTMC samples. Keeping 30 is an editorial cut; flows with the Balearic and Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla are not published.
path_note: The EPTMC gives the community where goods are loaded and the one where they are unloaded, not the way they go: the line is straight between the centres of the two communities.

commodities.6: Crude and manufactured minerals, building materials
commodities.9: Machinery, transport equipment, manufactured and miscellaneous articles
